notes: Blender space: metres, Z up, the character faces -Y. Distances in mm unless named _m.
Topology counts are on position-merged vertices (glTF splits vertices at UV seams); glTF stores only triangles, so ngons are 0 in the files (see source_ngons for the build's polygons).

Clipping: a skin vertex is 'covered' when a ray along its normal meets the layer within 5 cm (6 cm for hair), 'poke' when instead the layer's outward face lies up to 3 cm inside the skin. Percentages are of covered vertices.
Feminine looks move the skeleton by the customization file's Frame_Feminine offsets and the eye bones by their offset and eye_scale (what CS3 is meant to do).

shapes.reference_eye: adult eyeball about 24 mm, iris about 11.7 mm (scale by the head height ratio for this head)

reference.source: Drillis & Contini (1966) segment lengths as fractions of stature, reproduced in D. A. Winter, Biomechanics and Motor Control of Human Movement, 4th ed., 2009, fig. 4.1; heads tall = 1/0.130
